newsitem.title: UK: Cazenove Indian GDR Index rises 0.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Cazenove Indian GDR Index rises 0.3 pct.

text.p: The Cazenove Indian GDR Index was 0.29 points or 0.38 percent higher on Wednesday at 77.62, after the Bombay Stock Exchange 30 share index fell 17.5 points to a provisional 3,484.77.
The premium for GDRs over stocks on the local market was higher at 15.02 percent from 14.21 percent on Tuesday.
The Cazenove index is a capitalisation weighted basket of Indian global depositary receipts and measures the change from midday on the previous trading day to midday today.
